lines.en: label karinspring3:
scene bedroom_day
It’s been a week since I’ve heard anything from Karin.
lines.zh: 已经一个星期没有 Karin 的任何消息了。

lines.en: Which is fair, of course.
lines.zh: 当然，这很合理。

lines.en: I mean, I {i}did{/i} force myself on top of her in a private room and all. Even if it wasn’t really {i}me{/i} doing the forcing.
lines.zh: 毕竟，我{i}确实{/i}在包间里把她压在了身下。就算真正动手的并不是{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: But considering that I haven’t received so much as a follow-up from {i}anyone{/i} she knows makes me think she didn’t {i}tell{/i} anyone. And of course, that makes me question {i}why.{/i}
lines.zh: 但既然她认识的人里没有{i}一个{/i}来找过我，我想她大概没{i}告诉{/i}任何人。而这自然让我想问一句，{i}为什么。{/i}

lines.en: Perhaps it’s shock or embarrassment or shame or any of the reasons that made Molly keep things to herself after my run-in with her, but this is different than that.
lines.zh: 也许是震惊、难堪或羞耻——就像当初 Molly 在我跟她那次冲突之后选择一个人憋着一样。但这次不一样。

lines.en: For this, I was there — and forced to bear witness to the horrible things I was doing as I struggled to regain control of my body and my tongue.
lines.zh: 因为这一次，我在场——而且被迫亲眼目睹自己做的那些可怕的事，一边拼命想夺回对自己身体和舌头的控制。

lines.en: I guess it was deserved in a way, though. I’ve grown so complacent in the doing of my misdeeds that I’m all but desensitized to the vast majority of them at this point.
lines.zh: 不过从某种意义上说，这是我活该。我对自己的恶行已经麻木到这种地步，如今对其中绝大多数都几乎没什么感觉了。

lines.en: And the last time something like this happened, everything went dark in a much more literal sense. This time, I couldn’t even find a corner in the shadows of my mind to crawl to for safety.
lines.zh: 上一次发生这种事的时候，一切是字面意义上地黑了下去。而这一次，我连脑海阴影里一个能爬过去躲藏的角落都找不到。

lines.en: But maybe it was the fact that I was still somewhat {i}there{/i} this time that let me pull away before anything terrible happened.
lines.zh: 但也许正因为这一次我还算「{i}在场{/i}」，我才在更糟的事发生之前抽了身。

lines.en: Well, {i}more{/i} terrible. I can’t imagine being tackled by an adult male will do many favors for Karin’s androphobia.
lines.zh: 好吧，是{i}更{/i}糟的事。我实在想不出，被一个成年男性扑倒，能对 Karin 的男性恐惧症有什么好处。

lines.en: But one thing’s for sure, and it’s that I need to apologize. Sooner rather than later.
lines.zh: 但有一点是确定的，那就是我必须道歉。越早越好。

lines.en: Everything happened so fast that night in the karaoke booth that it was like the two of us just vanished.
lines.zh: 那晚在卡拉 OK 包厢里，一切都发生得太快，快得像我们俩凭空消失了一样。

lines.en: And while I’ve somehow managed to survive that once again, maybe Karin didn’t.
lines.zh: 而我虽然又一次奇迹般地活了下来，Karin 却未必。

lines.en: Maybe she actually {i}did{/i} vanish. And maybe the reason that I haven’t heard from her is that she’s decided to sever ties with me completely.
lines.zh: 也许她{i}真的{/i}消失了。也许我收不到她的消息，是因为她决定跟我彻底断绝往来。

lines.en: That’d make her the smartest out of everyone.
lines.zh: 那她就是所有人里最聪明的一个。

lines.en: But it would do {i}nothing{/i} for me.
lines.zh: 但这对我{i}毫无{/i}帮助。

lines.en: So I tap on her name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 于是我点开手机里她的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: And of course she doesn’t because that would have made things too easy.
lines.zh: 她当然没接，因为那样事情就太好办了。

lines.en: scene black
So, if I’m going to apologize to her, I’m going to have to do it the old fashioned way — by scouring town in the places she visits most for a chance to see her.
lines.zh: 所以，如果我想向她道歉，就得用老办法——把她常去的地方翻个遍，好逮到一个见她的机会。

lines.en: Waiting behind a tree or under the cover of darkness before jumping out and confronting her with a problem she’s afraid to confront on her own.
lines.zh: 躲在树后或者夜色里，然后跳出来，拿一个她自己不敢面对的问题去堵她。

lines.en: scene lr_noon
She’ll likely be too shocked to run, that poor fainting goat of a girl.
lines.zh: 她大概会惊到跑不动，那个像昏厥羊一样可怜的姑娘。

lines.en: But if paralyzing her legs is what I must do to make me feel like I’m a good person, by God will I do it.
lines.zh: 但如果非得让她的腿动不了，才能让我觉得自己是个好人，那我对天发誓，我一定会做。

lines.en: I’m a better boy now.
lines.zh: 我现在是个更好的男孩了。

lines.en: I have so much to show the world.
lines.zh: 我有那么多东西要展示给这个世界看。

lines.en: Suddenly, the bell rings.
lines.zh: 突然，门铃响了。

lines.en: scene black
Suddenly, I move to the front door.
lines.zh: 突然，我走向前门。

lines.en: scene sky
Suddenly, I open it.
lines.zh: 突然，我打开了门。

lines.en: scene karinsscarednow1
And suddenly, she is here.
lines.zh: 然后突然，她就在这儿了。

lines.en: Because, once again, I never have to work for anything.
lines.zh: 因为，又一次，我什么力气都不用费。

lines.en: It’s amazing what you can have delivered nowadays.
lines.zh: 如今能叫人送货上门的东西可真了不起。

lines.en: : Karin...
lines.zh: : Karin……

lines.en: scene karinsscarednow2
: I got your call.
lines.zh: : 我接到你的电话了。

lines.en: : That was like five minutes ago. Did you fly here?
lines.zh: : 那是五分钟前的事吧。你是飞过来的吗？

lines.en: : No. I’ve been in front of your house for like ten minutes trying to think of what I want to say.
lines.zh: : 不是。我在你家门口站了大概十分钟，一直在想该说什么。

lines.en: : Why should {i}you{/i} have to say anything? You didn’t do anything wrong.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}有什么好说的？你又没做错什么。

lines.en: : I know that. You did. But what I can’t figure out is {i}why.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我知道。做错的是我。但我想不明白的是{i}为什么。{/i}

lines.en: : You’ve been nothing but nice to me since we met. And apart from my dad, you were the only man I ever kind of...opened up to.
lines.zh: : 从我们认识起，你对我一直都很好。而且除了我爸，你是唯一一个我稍微……敞开心扉的男人。

lines.en: scene karinsscarednow3
: Was all of that just a lie?
lines.zh: : 那些全都是假的吗？

lines.en: if karinlied == True:
: Sometimes, lying is necessary to create the kind of future you want.
lines.zh: : 有些时候，撒谎是必要的，好创造出你想要的那种未来。

lines.en: : And what kind of future is it that {i}you{/i} want? How does leading me on make that achievable for you?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}想要的是什么样的未来？吊着我，对你实现它有什么帮助？

lines.en: else:
: I’ve never lied to you, Karin.
lines.zh: : 我从来没有对你撒过谎，Karin。

lines.en: : You’re lying again right now, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你现在就又在撒谎了，Sensei。

lines.en: : I might be naive, but I’m not an idiot. I’m one of the smartest girls in my grade. And even if I’m inexperienced with men, I can still tell when somebody is leading me on.
lines.zh: : 我也许是天真，但我不是傻子。我是年级里最聪明的女生之一。就算我对男人没什么经验，谁在吊着我我还是看得出来的。

lines.en: : You think I’m leading you on?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我在吊着你？

lines.en: : Are you not? Because everything you said when you had me pinned down seemed like it was tailor-made to make me bend to your will.
lines.zh: : 难道不是吗？因为你把我压在身下时说的那些话，听起来全都是专门为了让我屈从于你而设计的。

lines.en: scene karinsscarednow4
: I {i}trusted{/i} you...How could you do that to me?
lines.zh: : 我那么{i}信任{/i}你……你怎么能这样对我？

lines.en: : I didn’t {i}want{/i} to, Karin.
lines.zh: : 我也不{i}想{/i}那样，Karin。

lines.en: : You didn’t {i}want{/i} to? Am I just supposed to believe that?
lines.zh: : 你不{i}想{/i}？你以为我会信吗？

lines.en: : Listen...do you want to come inside and-
lines.zh: : 听我说……你想不想进屋来，然后——

lines.en: scene karinsscarednow5
: No. No way. I am {i}not{/i} coming inside your house. Not after what you did to me. If we’re going to talk, we can do it out here.
lines.zh: : 不。绝不。在你对我做了那种事之后，我{i}不会{/i}进你家。要谈的话，就在外面谈。

lines.en: Karin takes a step back and nearly knocks over the neighbor’s bike- and I have to prevent myself from reflexively reaching forward to stop it from falling because I know that doing that will just scare her now.
lines.zh: Karin 后退一步，差点撞倒邻居的自行车——我得强忍住本能，不让自己伸手去扶，因为我知道现在那么做只会吓到她。

lines.en: That’s just an obstacle I’m always going to have to deal with from now on, I guess.
lines.zh: 我想，从今往后这就是我永远要面对的一道障碍。

lines.en: And yes, it’s my fault. Yes, the burden of the reflex itself will weigh heavier on her than it does on me. But it’s one more added inconvenience to a life already full of them.
lines.zh: 是的，是我的错。是的，这种本能反应带来的负担，压在她身上会比我更重。但这不过是她本已充满不便的生活里，又多出来的一个不便。

lines.en: I don’t have room for many more.
lines.zh: 我已经没有余地再承受更多了。

lines.en: : That...is fair. I’m sorry for suggesting it.
lines.zh: : 那……也合理。抱歉，我不该提这个。

lines.en: : It’s...fine. I just...
lines.zh: : 没……没事。我只是……

lines.en: scene karinsscarednow6
: I...need to know just what was real and what was fake. Because...you were important to me. In a way that other people never were...
lines.zh: : 我……需要知道什么是真的，什么是假的。因为……你对我来说很重要。重要到其他人从来没有过的那种程度……

lines.en: : Do you understand what I'm saying?...
lines.zh: : 你明白我在说什么吗？……

lines.en: : Do you like me, Karin?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢我吗，Karin？

lines.en: : I mean...I’m in high school. You’re way older than me and...it’s hard to tell if what I felt for you was just...admiration or...you know...other stuff, but...
lines.zh: : 我是说……我还在上高中。你比我大那么多，而且……我很难说清我对你的感觉到底只是……崇拜，还是……你知道的……别的东西，不过……

lines.en: : But now...
lines.zh: : 但现在……

lines.en: scene karinsscarednow7
: I’m kind of just...{i}afraid{/i} of you.
lines.zh: : 我现在只是……有点{i}怕{/i}你。

lines.en: : I used to smile every time Kirin or somebody else brought you up. Now, I just want to cry.
lines.zh: : 以前每次 Kirin 或别人提起你，我都会笑。现在，我只想哭。

lines.en: : And so...it might be pointless for me to come here and try to find closure or...even an answer to any of my questions. Especially since you’re not even coming to school anymore.
lines.zh: : 所以……我跑来找你，想做个了断，或者……哪怕只是为我的任何一个问题找到答案，可能都没什么意义。尤其是你现在连学校都不来了。

lines.en: : But I felt like I had to...because I don’t want to feel those depressing feelings anymore. I have a younger sister I need to set a good example for. And I can’t do that if my head won’t stop spinning.
lines.zh: : 但我觉得我必须来……因为我不想再被那些压抑的情绪缠着了。我还有个妹妹要我给她做榜样。要是我的脑子一直晕个不停，我就做不到。

lines.en: : So you’re confronting the same man who pinned you down head-on? Isn’t that a little too...daring?
lines.zh: : 所以你就这么正面去找那个把你压在身下的男人对质？这会不会有点太……大胆了？

lines.en: : Is that a threat? Because I’m more than willing to walk away now. I just thought things might not come to that because of the way they left off.
lines.zh: : 这是在威胁我吗？因为我现在非常愿意转身就走。我只是觉得，看上次分开时的样子，事情也许不至于走到那一步。

lines.en: : When you pulled yourself off of me, you looked different. You looked regretful. Was that a lie too? Do you only regret it because I kept saying no?
lines.zh: : 你从我身上起来的时候，样子不一样了。你看起来很后悔。那也是假的吗？你后悔，只是因为我不停地说不吗？

lines.en: : What {i}was{/i} that, Sensei? All of it. Why? Why would you do that?
lines.zh: : 那到底{i}是{/i}什么，Sensei？这一切。为什么？你为什么要那么做？

lines.en: scene karinsscarednow8
: I won’t ask you to come inside again, but would you like to maybe...go for a walk or something? So I can try to explain.
lines.zh: : 我不会再请你进屋了，不过你愿不愿意……去走走什么的？好让我试着解释一下。

lines.en: : A walk where? Because I’d like to stay in public for now.
lines.zh: : 走到哪儿去？因为我现在想待在人多的地方。

lines.en: : Just down the road. We probably don’t have to worry about Ami leaving her room right now, but I’d still feel a little more comfortable knowing she can’t pop out and listen to this whenever she wants.
lines.zh: : 就沿着这条路。现在大概不用担心 Ami 会走出房间，不过知道她没法随时跳出来听这些，我还是会自在一些。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’d want to keep this a secret from her if I were you as well.
lines.zh: : 嗯……换作是我，也不想让她知道这些。

lines.en: scene black
: Come on...let’s go.
lines.zh: : 走吧……我们走。

lines.en: Karin takes off down the same path I used to take to school every morning.
lines.zh: Karin 沿着我以前每天早上走去学校的那条路迈开了步子。

lines.en: And while I am no stranger to descending this seemingly never-ending flight of stone steps, it feels different this time. It feels {i}harder.{/i}
lines.zh: 这段看似没有尽头的石阶我早就走惯了，可这一次感觉不一样。感觉{i}更难{/i}走。

lines.en: And here I thought hanging my head would have the opposite effect.
lines.zh: 我还以为低着头会有相反的效果呢。

lines.en: scene karinsscarednow9
Not wanting to get {i}too{/i} far away from Ami, I point to a nearby bench and the two of us take a seat.
lines.zh: 不想离 Ami {i}太{/i}远，我指了指附近的一张长椅，我们俩坐了下来。

lines.en: I’m surprised when Karin lets me sit beside her, but I guess she feels a little more secure knowing that there would be onlookers if I were to try something again.
lines.zh: Karin 居然同意我坐在她旁边，这让我有点意外，但我想，知道我要是再动手动脚就会有人看见，她会更有安全感一些。

lines.en: Unfortunately for her, I’m not sure such a thing would stop me. But, then again, I still have no clue what the new voices in my head even {i}want,{/i} so maybe they’re just waiting for me to get her alone.
lines.zh: 对她来说不幸的是，我并不确定这就能拦住我。不过话说回来，我连脑子里那些新的声音到底{i}想要{/i}什么都不清楚，所以也许它们只是在等我跟她独处。

lines.en: Whatever the case, they’re not bothering me today.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，它们今天没来烦我。

lines.en: Like I said a week ago, some days are worse than others.
lines.zh: 就像我一星期前说的，有些日子比另一些日子更糟。

lines.en: And all we can do is hope things stay that way.
lines.zh: 而我们能做的，只有祈祷情况就这么保持下去。

lines.en: : Before I start saying a whole bunch of things that won’t make any sense to you, I just want you to know that you’re one of the last people I’d ever want to hurt.
lines.zh: : 在我开始说一大堆你听不懂的话之前，我只想让你知道，你是我最不想伤害的人之一。

lines.en: : It’s probably hard to believe that right now given what I did last week, but it’s true. You’re one of the few irrefutably kind souls I’ve encountered in this city.
lines.zh: : 考虑到我上星期做的事，这大概很难让人相信，但这是真的。你是我在这座城市里遇到过的、为数不多无可否认的善良灵魂之一。

lines.en: : So much so that I feel like even being near you is a sin. Like some...parasite is going to fall out of my ears and latch onto you and turn you less {i}good{/i} or something.
lines.zh: : 以至于我觉得光是待在你身边都是一种罪。就像有什么……寄生虫会从我的耳朵里掉出来，爬到你身上，把你变得不那么{i}好{/i}之类的。

lines.en: : That’s...kind of gross...
lines.zh: : 那……有点恶心……

lines.en: : Yeah...it is. Isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啊。可不是吗。

lines.en: : Karin, I’m a miserable man.
lines.zh: : Karin，我这个人很可悲。

lines.en: scene karinsscarednow10
: And I’ve been that way forever, I think.
lines.zh: : 而且我想，我一直都是这样。

lines.en: : You already know a little about my memory issues, but something I don’t think you understand yet is what {i}other{/i} sorts of...malfunctions I’ve got going on in my head.
lines.zh: : 我的记忆问题你已经知道一些了，但我想你还不明白的是，我脑子里还有{i}别的{/i}什么……故障。

lines.en: : You know how in cartoons, they’ll always use a devil and an angel on someone’s shoulders to symbolize their conscience? Well...for me, there is no angel. And I never even get to {i}see{/i} the devil.
lines.zh: : 你知道动画片里，他们总会在人肩膀上放一个小恶魔和一个小天使，来象征良知吗？嗯……对我来说，天使是不存在的。而那个恶魔，我甚至从来都{i}见{/i}不到。

lines.en: : He’s there. I can hear him almost constantly. And he’s taken up residence somewhere inside of me that I’m pretty sure I’d never even be able to reach without the help of a shotgun.
lines.zh: : 他在那儿。我几乎无时无刻都能听见他。而且他住在我体内的某个地方，我敢肯定，没有猎枪帮忙我这辈子都够不着那儿。

lines.en: : Sensei, stop.
lines.zh: : Sensei，别说了。

lines.en: : I’m not going to do anything, don’t worry. I’m too much of a coward. And this alone is barely enough to call an explanation or...even an {i}excuse.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我不会做什么的，别担心。我太懦弱了。而这些话本身，勉强算不上一个解释，甚至……算不上一个{i}借口。{/i}

lines.en: : I’m just not {i}me{/i} sometimes. Like, I can’t control myself. And before I know it, I’m doing something terrible or...just {i}did{/i} something terrible.
lines.zh: : 我只是有时候不是{i}我自己{/i}。就是说，我控制不住自己。等我回过神来，我正在做可怕的事，或者……刚刚{i}做完{/i}了可怕的事。

lines.en: : But then I switch back to normal and have to deal with the aftermath.
lines.zh: : 然后我又切回正常，还得收拾残局。

lines.en: : Doesn’t that sound a little too...um...convenient? As an excuse, I mean.
lines.zh: : 这听起来是不是有点太……嗯……太顺手了？我是说，作为借口的话。

lines.en: : Anyone can do bad things to people and then say that something {i}made{/i} them do it. And that’s rarely ever true.
lines.zh: : 谁都可以对别人做了坏事，然后说是有什么东西{i}逼{/i}自己做的。而这种说法几乎没有一个是真的。

lines.en: : I know that. Which is why I don’t expect you to believe me and am prepared for this to be the last talk we ever have. I’m just trying to explain myself since I think it would be good for you to have closure too.
lines.zh: : 我知道。所以我并不指望你相信我，也做好了这是我们最后一次谈话的准备。我只是想解释一下自己，因为我觉得，你能有个了断也是好事。

lines.en: : It’s been really hard for me ever since Halloween. I lost someone I loved. And it’s affecting me in ways that, while expected, are still {i}pretty fucking{/i} unexpected.
lines.zh: : 从万圣节之后，我的日子一直很难熬。我失去了一个我爱的人。而它对我的影响，虽说在意料之中，却又{i}他妈的{/i}出乎意料。

lines.en: : And if that sounds contradictory, it’s because it is.
lines.zh: : 如果这听起来自相矛盾，那是因为它确实矛盾。

lines.en: : I know that it’s nearly impossible to predict how grief or loss will hit a person. But if you told me a year or two ago the state I’d be in now, I’d likely have laughed in your face.
lines.zh: : 我知道，悲伤和失去会怎么击垮一个人，几乎是无法预测的。但要是你在一年或两年前告诉我，我会变成现在这副样子，我大概会当面笑出来。

lines.en: : I’m not emotionally equipped to deal with things like loss. I’m not you. And yeah, I’m older, but that doesn’t mean I’m any more whole...or even someone you should look up to.
lines.zh: : 我在情感上没有能力去应付「失去」这种事。我不是你。而且，是的，我年纪更大，但这不代表我比你更完整……甚至不代表我是个值得你仰望的人。

lines.en: : I’m...sorry to hear all of that, Sensei. But I still don’t think any of that explains why you tackled me the way you did.
lines.zh: : 听你这么说，我……很遗憾，Sensei。但我仍然不觉得这些能解释你为什么要用那种方式扑到我身上。

lines.en: : I don’t think anything {i}can{/i} explain why I tackled you the way I did. So if that’s the sort of closure you’re looking for, I’m not going to be able to help.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没有任何东西{i}能{/i}解释我为什么那么扑上去。所以如果你想要的那种了断是这个，我帮不了你。

lines.en: : But if you want to know how much was {i}real{/i} and how much was {i}fake,{/i} I’m going to need more specific questions.
lines.zh: : 但如果你想知道哪些是{i}真的{/i}、哪些是{i}假{/i}的，那我需要更具体的问题。

lines.en: scene karinsscarednow11
: Specific, huh?...
lines.zh: : 具体，是吗？……

lines.en: : Then...let’s start with this.
lines.zh: : 那么……先从这个问题开始吧。

lines.en: : Were you...already aware of how I felt about you?
lines.zh: : 你……早就知道我对你是什么感觉吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
: Did you know Miku was going to leave us alone?
lines.zh: : 你知道 Miku 会留下我们两个人吗？

lines.en: : She mentioned something about it earlier. But there was a lot more on my mind when we made it to the karaoke booth.
lines.zh: : 她之前提过一点。但我们到卡拉 OK 包厢的时候，我脑子里装的东西要多得多。

lines.en: : What was on your mind?
lines.zh: : 你脑子里在想什么？

lines.en: : Something completely unrelated to both of you.
lines.zh: : 一些跟你们俩完全无关的事。

lines.en: scene karinsscarednow12
: Are you attracted to me?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我有吸引力吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
: Do you know how old I am?
lines.zh: : 你知道我多大吗？

lines.en: : And that doesn’t change anything about the way you feel?
lines.zh: : 这也没有改变你对我的感觉？

lines.en: : I really wish it did.
lines.zh: : 我真希望它能。

lines.en: : Have you ever thought about hurting me before?
lines.zh: : 你以前有没有想过要伤害我？

lines.en: : Not intentionally.
lines.zh: : 不是有意的。

lines.en: : Why think that way at all?
lines.zh: : 那为什么会那样想？

lines.en: : Because I think that way about everyone. I can’t help it.
lines.zh: : 因为我对所有人都会那样想。我控制不了。

lines.en: : If I didn’t try to stop you...what would you have done?
lines.zh: : 如果我没有试着阻止你……你会做出什么？

lines.en: : Would you have followed through?...
lines.zh: : 你会做到底吗？……

lines.en: : Or would the outcome have been the same?
lines.zh: : 还是说结果还是一样的？

lines.en: : I really have no clue...
lines.zh: : 我真的毫无头绪……

lines.en: : Have you been grooming me this entire time?
lines.zh: : 你从头到尾一直在对我进行情感操控吗？

lines.en: scene karinsscarednow13
: Karin...
lines.zh: : Karin……

lines.en: : Have you been faking it all along? All those phone calls...all those conversations...was all of that just to make me let you in?
lines.zh: : 你一直都在演戏吗？那些电话……那些对话……难道全都是为了让我对你卸下防备？

lines.en: : It’s a lot more complicated than that...
lines.zh: : 事情比那复杂得多……

lines.en: : Do you love me, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你爱我吗，Sensei？

lines.en: scene karinsscarednow14
scene karinsscarednow15
: No.
lines.zh: : 不爱。

lines.en: scene karinsscarednow16
: Thanks for clearing all of that up.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你把这些都说清楚了。

lines.en: : I know how it sounds...but I didn’t want to do that, Karin. I seriously couldn’t help it. I’d never do anything like that to you on purpose.
lines.zh: : 我知道这听起来像什么……但我真的不想那么做，Karin。我是真的控制不了。我绝不会故意对你做那种事。

lines.en: : No...you’d just string me along until you know that I trust you...
lines.zh: : 不……你只是会一直吊着我，直到你确定我信任你……

lines.en: : You’d pepper me with compliments...and flirt with me despite knowing how I felt...while continuing to call me and hang out with me, but never intending to actually take things anywhere...
lines.zh: : 你会不停地夸我……明知道我的心意还跟我调情……继续给我打电话、跟我出去玩，却从来没打算真的把关系推进到哪一步……

lines.en: : I’ve just been a toy for you, haven’t I?
lines.zh: : 我对你来说就是个玩具，对吧？

lines.en: : No...you’re so much more than that.
lines.zh: : 不……你远不止如此。

lines.en: scene karinsscarednow17
: You know...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……

lines.en: : It feels weird to say this...but I’d be way more inclined to forgive you right now if you told me you just got caught up in the moment back then.
lines.zh: : 说这个感觉挺怪的……但现在如果你告诉我，你当时只是一时冲动，我会更愿意原谅你。

lines.en: : If what you wanted when you tackled me was real...and you were just misreading the moment or...misunderstanding my experience with stuff like that...
lines.zh: : 如果你扑上来时想要的是真的……你只是误读了当时的气氛，或者……误解了我在这方面的经验……

lines.en: : That would have been {i}so{/i} much better than finding out none of it meant anything.
lines.zh: : 那总比发现这一切毫无意义要{i}好得多{/i}。

lines.en: : Just because I don’t love you doesn’t mean I can never-
lines.zh: : 我不爱你，并不代表我永远都不能——

lines.en: : Sensei...I’m sorry, but you’ll never be able to love {i}anyone{/i} like this.
lines.zh: : Sensei……对不起，但你这样是永远没办法爱上{i}任何人{/i}的。

lines.en: : And I don’t know what it was that made your world go dark, but I hope you can figure out how to move past it.
lines.zh: : 我不知道是什么让你的世界黑了下来，但我希望你能想办法跨过去。

lines.en: : You’re really pitiful like this. But the worst part is I can’t even feel bad for you since it’s all your fault.
lines.zh: : 你这副样子真的很可怜。但最糟的是，我连同情你都做不到，因为这一切都是你的错。

lines.en: : Karin-
lines.zh: : Karin——

lines.en: : I won’t tell anyone about what happened since you {i}did{/i} come clean...but I do think you should stay away from my sister and me for a while.
lines.zh: : 既然你坦白了，我不会把这件事告诉任何人……但我{i}确实{/i}觉得，你该离我和我妹妹远一点。

lines.en: : I don’t feel safe when you’re around. And I don’t want you hurting {i}her{/i} either.
lines.zh: : 你在我身边，我就没有安全感。我也不想让你伤害{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: : I’m gonna go home now...but thanks for talking to me.
lines.zh: : 我要回家了……不过还是谢谢你跟我说这些。

lines.en: : And please...try to figure yourself out.
lines.zh: : 还有，请你……想办法把自己理清楚。

lines.en: scene black
: You’re nothing like the man I thought you were.
lines.zh: : 你跟我以为的那个人完全不一样。

lines.en: In that moment, I finally find the benefit of hanging my head.
lines.zh: 就在那一刻，我终于发现了低着头的好处。

lines.en: It’s that I don’t have to see her walk away.
lines.zh: 那就是，我不用看着她走远。

lines.en: As I head back home, I make one more mental note amidst a sea of pre-existing annotations.
lines.zh: 在回家的路上，我在一片早已密密麻麻的批注中，又添了一条新的备忘。

lines.en: All this one says is that her chapter is still open.
lines.zh: 这一条只写着：她的篇章还没有结束。

lines.en: And that I was a fool for thinking I could jump to the epilogue.
lines.zh: 还有，以为自己能直接跳到尾声，我可真是个傻瓜。

lines.en: $ karinspring3 = True
$ karin_love -= 10
{i}Karin’s affection has decreased by 10!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Karin 的好感度下降了 10!{/i}

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
It isn’t until nightfall that I’m ready to go back outside.
lines.zh: 直到天黑，我才准备好再次出门。
